query:
SELECT p.id, p.residentId, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.isActive, 
       (p.totalHours - p.usedHours) as remainingMinutes,
       r.firstName, r.lastName
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON r.id = p.residentId
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 1;
